_comment: Mock request and response shapes for Apple's endpoints and for the web form_post return. Use to stub Apple in unit and integration tests. All values are invented; no real keys, ids or codes.
_usage: Serve `jwks` from a stub of the signing-key endpoint; assert outgoing requests against `token_request`, `revoke_request`, `client_secret_*`; post `callback_form_*` to the web callback.
_provenance: Endpoint paths, field names and error codes are from Apple documentation as the block author knows it (MEDIUM, confirm). Not captured from real traffic.

jwks._comment: Shape of the signing-keys response. Replace n with the modulus of the test RS256 key.

authorize_redirect_params._comment: Query parameters the start endpoint must put on the authorize redirect. state and nonce are per-attempt random values; nonce is the hex SHA-256 of the raw nonce held in the pre-auth cookie.

callback_form_first_authorization._comment: application/x-www-form-urlencoded fields Apple posts on a user's first authorization of the app. The user field is a JSON string.

callback_form_returning._comment: Later authorizations carry no user field.

callback_form_cancelled._comment: Posted when the user cancels on Apple's page.

callback_form_bad_user_field._comment: user is not valid JSON. Sign-in must still succeed with a null name.

client_secret_claims._comment: Claims of the ES256 client secret the revoke flow mints. Team id and key id are placeholders.

token_request._comment: Form fields the backend sends to the token endpoint to exchange a fresh authorization code. client_id is the bundle id for native, the Services ID for web.

token_response_invalid_grant._comment: Code expired, already used, or issued for another client id.

revoke_response_error._comment: Simulates a failed revoke: status 400 with this body. The deletion flow still proceeds.

seed_users._comment: Seed rows for linking and revocation scenarios. Columns not listed take their defaults.
